title: CODA: Depth-Aligned Scene Completion and Object Decomposition from a Single RGB-D Image
abstract: arXiv:2609.25654v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robots operating safely in cluttered everyday environments often need to infer scene geometry from partial observations. Methods that detect objects in 2D and reconstruct them independently struggle in such scenes: a missed object is never reconstructed, a merged detection can fuse two objects, and separately reconstructed meshes may overlap or fail to touch their supporting surfaces. We introduce CODA (Complete Once, Decompose Afterward), a generative model that instead reconstructs the complete scene geometry from a single unsegmented RGB-D image, then separates the surface into the surrounding environment and movable objects. Still, generated scene geometry can drift from the observed partial point cloud. To reduce this drift, CODA uses two explicit 3D grounding mechanisms to keep reconstructed geometry consistent with observed surfaces while completing unseen regions. Experiments on HomebrewedDB and our custom cluttered-scene datas

translated_title: CODA：基于单张RGB-D图像的深度对齐场景补全与物体分解
translated_abstract: 在杂乱的日常环境中安全运行的机器人通常需要从部分观测中推断场景几何。先在2D中检测物体再独立重建的方法在此类场景中表现不佳：漏检的物体永远不会被重建，合并的检测可能将两个物体融合在一起，而单独重建的网格可能相互重叠或无法接触其支撑表面。我们提出了CODA（先补全，后分解），这是一种生成模型，它从单张未分割的RGB-D图像重建完整的场景几何，然后将表面分离为周围环境和可移动物体。然而，生成的场景几何可能会偏离观测到的部分点云。为了减少这种偏差，CODA使用两种显式的3D接地机制，在补全未见区域的同时保持重建几何与观测表面的一致性。在HomebrewedDB和我们自建的杂乱场景数据集上的实验（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: CODA提出了一种生成模型，从单张未分割的RGB-D图像先补全完整场景几何，再将其分解为周围环境与可移动物体，并通过两种显式3D接地机制保证重建结果与观测深度对齐。
en_tdlr: CODA is a generative model that first completes full scene geometry from a single unsegmented RGB-D image and then decomposes it into the environment and movable objects, using two explicit 3D grounding mechanisms to keep the reconstruction aligned with the observed depth.
